question: Which among the following is a ritual of cleaning the earth as well as worshipping the fourteen gods in Tripura, India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kharchi Puja.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kharchi Puja:-**

 
 
• It​ is an important festival of **Tripura, India, **which is celebrated in the month of **July** after the Ambubachi Mela in Guwahati.
 
• It is a **seven-day long festival **in which the earth is **cleaned **and the** fourteen gods** are worshipped to seek their blessings and protection.
 
• The festival is celebrated by the **Tripuri people **who believe that it helps to maintain the **ecological balance and harmony** between humans and nature.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tusu:-**

 
 
• Tusu is a folk festival celebrated in the Indian states of West Bengal, Jharkhand, and Odisha.
 
• It is a harvest festival that is celebrated on the last day of the Hindu month of Paush, which is also known as Makar Sankranti.
 
 
 
• **Durga Puja:-**
 
 
• **​**Durga Puja is a Hindu festival that is celebrated by Hindus in India and other countries around the world.
 
• It is a festival dedicated to the worship of the goddess Durga, who is the goddess of power and devotion in Hinduism.
 
• Durga Puja is typically celebrated in the month of Ashwin, which falls in September or October.
 
 
 
• ** ****Bani:-**
 
 
• **​**Bani dance is a traditional Rajasthani folk dance performed by women.
 
• It is a lively and energetic dance that is often performed during weddings and festivals.
